name: btc-5m-binary-fade
_hypothesis: Fade, do not follow. Every trend-following gate in the menu measured significantly below break-even on a real year of BTCUSDT 5-minute bars (trend_alignment 48.01%, z = -17.7; persistence z = -12.3; momentum_thrust z = -14.6; participation z = -16.7). mean_reversion was the only gate with a positive sign (53.46%, z = +1.1, not established). Real 5-minute BTC returns carry a lag-1 autocorrelation of about -0.03, which is the same direction. This config is that one hypothesis and nothing else: the mean_reversion gate as the sole direction vote, data_integrity as the precondition, and the predict.fun risk and betting settings unchanged from configs/predict-fun-bnb-5m.json.
_third_gate: session is here because the validator requires three gates, not because it is part of the hypothesis. It was chosen before any data was seen, for two structural reasons: it is a veto with no direction vote, so it cannot pick a side, and it reads only the clock, so it shares no feature with mean_reversion. Its parameters are pinned to the library defaults: every hour allowed, weekends allowed, only a +/-5 minute blackout around the 00/08/16 UTC funding marks -- about 2% of bars. If it ever shows up as a material filter in the results, that is a finding to report, not a knob to turn.
_protocol: Fixed on 2026-09-13 BEFORE any of the development or holdout data was fetched or examined. Development set: the year ending 2024-09-13. Holdout: the year ending 2025-09-13. The year ending 2026-09-13 is contaminated -- its gate scores were read while choosing this hypothesis -- and is reported only as a third, lower-trust confirmation. The holdout is touched once. If this file changes after a holdout result has been read, that holdout is burned and a fresh one must be cut from earlier history. Pre-registered pass criterion, on the holdout: mean_reversion edge vs the 52.00% break-even above +1.0% with z >= +2 in the gate table, AND the backtest does not halt. Anything less means the hypothesis fails and the work stops.
_params_pinned: mean_reversion parameters are written out explicitly rather than inherited, so a later change to the defaults in config.py cannot silently alter the hypothesis under test. They are the library defaults as of the date above, untouched.
